contexts.text: A reddish glow of diamond light.
There are atmospheres which resemble the sparkling of all the precious stones.
The flowers there sparkle... This sparkling there is something of intelligence and wisdom... from which they have the sparkling.
(The rays are diffused) according to the sparkling and flaming in the object.
With those who are in falsity from evil, this light is glowing... The glory of the world, which is from the love of self; kindles it, and causes its glowing.
Lightnings = the glowing and resplendence of those truths; for Divine truths shine and glow from the flaming of the light...
The Lord was seen as a Sun, at first glittering and coruscating in such splendour... (This) glittering and coruscating began to grow dim. SE 4639.
That Sun appeared (to me) fiery like our sun, but glowing red more.
The light of the higher Heavens is so shining white... and also so glowing red...
Celestial light is a flaming glowing light...
Glowing with the colour of the human face.
It glistened like the shell of a snail.
The glow from (that golden light) enlightened their temples...
